topic: A Sanad office in Muscat moved 40 client work permits off WhatsApp — no missed renewals in six months
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
Before SmartPRO Hub, a Sanad office in Muscat was tracking 40 client work permits across WhatsApp threads, forwarded screenshots, and a shared notes doc that three people were editing simultaneously.

After: one dashboard. Every permit, every expiry date, every renewal status — visible to the whole team, in real time.

Six months in: zero missed renewals.

That's a completely different operation.

Work permit renewals aren't complicated. The problem is that reminders living inside someone's head, or buried three screens deep in a chat thread, get missed. A missed permit means a fine, a blocked employee, and a client who won't forget it.

SmartPRO Hub built Sanad office management software specifically for this. Not a workaround. Not a spreadsheet with color-coded tabs that only one person actually understands. A purpose-built workflow that tracks every permit, fires reminders before deadlines, and gives clients visibility through a branded portal — no WhatsApp required.

And Sanad didn't stop at 40 permits. They scaled.

Here's the thing about managing renewals through chat threads: the risk doesn't announce itself. You don't know there's a problem until something gets missed. By then it's already a fine or a frustrated client.

How many permits is your team tracking manually right now?
